subject.title: [Feature]: Add an optional result-return mode for /hooks/agent

question: Should `POST /hooks/agent` grow an opt-in synchronous result-return mode, and if so what response shape, announcement behavior, error disclosure, redaction, timeout, concurrency, and replay limits should be required?
rationale: The code change is feasible, but exposing agent output through authenticated external hook ingress changes a stable gateway HTTP/API security boundary and cannot be safely chosen by automation.

options.title: Narrow and land the linked PR
options.body: Approve a `waitForResult`-style mode after adding or confirming explicit limits for result bytes, redaction/control-character handling, bounded waits, replay behavior, and non-ok error shape.

options.title: Choose a separate result fetch contract
options.body: Reject synchronous output on the hook POST and instead design a short-lived result URL or polling contract with its own auth and retention rules.

options.title: Keep hooks async-only
options.body: Close the feature direction and document `POST /hooks/agent` plus `sessions_history` as the supported automation pattern.

recommendation.title: Narrow and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Approve a `waitForResult`-style mode after adding or confirming explicit limits for result bytes, redaction/control-character handling, bounded waits, replay behavior, and non-ok error shape.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest hook/gateway security-history signal and was explicitly requested for API-shape review in the discussion.
